newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar moves higher, August heads volume.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar moves higher, August heads volume.

text.p: LIFFE sugar moved higher, with trade concentrated on August and, to a lesser extent, October.
There was a high proportion of switch and some AA trades, traders said.
By 1608 GMT August was $4.20 higher at $326.20, with 1,637 out of a total 2,999 lots done.
The most notable feature of the market was the widening of the spread between August and October, traders said. October last traded $1.00 higher at $316.80. October volume was 1,061 lots.
"The August/October switch has been pushed out. There's nothing else happening," one trader said.
